message.content:
Soft knit sweater with dropped shoulders, relaxed fit, oatmeal color #d1ab86, fine merino wool.  
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in dark wash denim, straight cut through the leg, length to ankle bone, color #2e3530, 98% cotton/2% elastane.  
Minimalist flat sneaker with white rubber sole and leather upper, clean silhouette, color #f5f5f0, smooth leather.  

This outfit balances your morning yoga needs with a polished look for coffee with friends. The relaxed sweater allows full movement during practice while the high-waisted denim provides structure without being too formal. Neutral earth tones harmonize beautifully with your warm skin and hair, keeping you comfortable yet effortlessly stylish throughout the day.
